title: 第一卷 第5章 我带你去第一卷 第6章 只要你的命
slug: 徒儿下山祸害你七个师姐去吧
content_zh:
;;
卢锐立将目光落在叶青云的身上，眼神微眯，冷冷开口。
“是你打伤了我的人？”
“对，带我去见‘黑玫瑰’。”
叶青云开口道。
卢锐立闻言，心中一沉。
妈的，今天是什么狗屎运？
刚才被一个贱女人踹到命根子。
现在又来了一个不知死活的小子在他家门口闹事。
卢锐立面露戾气，在腰间一摸索，掏出一把手枪，对着叶青云就是一枪。
“哪里来的不知死活的小子？！啊？！
打伤了我的人，还敢命令我？！给我死！”
砰！
一颗子弹夹杂的破风声对叶青云射去。
这个距离，卢锐立有把握，这一枪可以崩掉这小子的脑袋！
刀疤男脸上浮现残忍的笑容。
“小子，我承认你很能打。
再能打有什么用？还能打得过枪……”
刀疤男这句话还没说完，瞳孔剧烈收缩，满脸震惊！
“什么？！”

只见，叶青云抬起右手，在身前比画一个剪刀状。
一颗黑色的物体在他的手中旋转。
由于速度过快，甚至冒出了缕缕白烟。
众人定睛一看，叶青云手指间的正是一颗子弹！
顿时！
这片区域死一般的寂静！
紧接着，就是接二连三吸气的声音。
刀疤男喉咙滚动，极度不可思议的说道。
“这……怎么可能？！”
这时，他看向叶青云的目光满是敬畏！
铛！
叶青云随意地把子弹丢在地上。
这一声轻响，让不少人心猛地一震。
众人满脸畏惧地看向叶青云。
叶青云再次对卢锐立说道。
“带我去见‘黑玫瑰’。”
卢锐立全身一抖，重重回道。
“阁下是谁？找我主上有何贵干？”
“这不是你该考虑的事。
我再说一遍，带我去见‘黑玫瑰’。

不然，你死。”
叶青云说完，眼神中闪过一抹凶光。
别看叶青云这五年全待在山上。
但，他身上这股杀气是货真价实的！
老头在山上专门施展幻境让叶青云训练。

Lu Rui immediately cast his gaze on Ye Qingyun, narrowed his eyes slightly, and spoke coldly.
"Did you hurt my man?"
"Yes, take me to see 'Black Rose'."
Ye Qingyun said.
When Lu Ruili heard this, his heart sank.
Damn, what kind of shit is your luck today?
I was kicked to the core by a bitch just now.
Now here comes another reckless boy causing trouble in front of his house.
Lu Rui looked fierce, groped around his waist, took out a pistol, and shot Ye Qingyun.
“Where did this reckless kid come from?! Huh?!
You dared to order me after you injured me? ! Die! "
Bang!
A bullet shot towards Ye Qingyun with a blast of wind.
At this distance, Lu Ruili was confident that this shot could blow this kid's head off!
A cruel smile appeared on the scarred man's face.
"Boy, I admit that you are very good at fighting.
What's the use of being able to fight again? I can still shoot with a gun..."
Before the scarred man finished speaking, his pupils shrank violently and his face was full of shock!
"What?!"
I saw Ye Qingyun raising his right hand and making a scissor shape in front of him.
A black object spun in his hand.
Due to the speed, wisps of white smoke even came out.
Everyone took a closer look and saw that what was between Ye Qingyun's fingers was a bullet!
Suddenly!
This area is deathly silent!
Immediately afterwards, there was the sound of inhaling one after another.
The scarred man's throat rolled and he said in extreme disbelief.
"How...how is this possible?!"
At this time, he looked at Ye Qingyun with eyes filled with awe!
clang!
Ye Qingyun casually dropped the bullet on the ground.
This soft sound shocked many people's hearts.
Everyone looked at Ye Qingyun with fear on their faces.
Ye Qingyun said to Lu Ruili again.
"Take me to see 'Black Rose'."
Lu Ruili's whole body trembled and he replied heavily.
"Who is your Excellency? What do you want from my lord?"
“This is not something you should think about.
I say it again, take me to see the ‘Black Rose’.
Otherwise, you die. "
After Ye Qingyun finished speaking, a fierce light flashed in his eyes.
Don't look at Ye Qingyun staying in the mountains for the past five years.
However, the murderous aura in him is genuine!
The old man specially used illusions on the mountain for Ye Qingyun to train.
